official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Create editable scientific 3D animations from a description, find your existing projects and request revisions. Browse your projects as a gallery, watch their preview films and follow progress in the conversation, then open Animiotics to use the full editor and export a video. Requires an Animiotics account. Creation and edits use your existing account allowance. Review generated scientific content before using it.
